name: alert
title: Alert
description: An inline notice with an optional icon, title and body in four tones. Warnings and errors interrupt screen readers; info and success are polite.

props.name: variant
props.description: Tone of the notice. Warning and destructive use role alert, the others role status.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional leading icon, hidden from screen readers.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
